title: Benchmark: a store in the cloud against a local copy
text: One store 101 catalog entries (98 small tables, table 1e6 rows partitioned year 15 files 28.3 MB together, 1e5 polygons index table; 220 files, 40.8 MB) written local folder files copied unchanged random prefix test bucket, removed end. measure timed bench_run() (five repetitions, median reported). Connect: store_connect() local copy; bucket cold (Arrow file system access token created every repetition, new R session) warm. Reads: store_read() streaming bucket; dataset’s files downloaded whole (be_get()) empty folder; store_read() local copy. Download--read sum last two. MD5: be_md5() table’s files (object metadata bucket, hashing files local copy), store_check() without x (MD5, rows schema Parquet footers). Sync: store_sync() polygons index table local store new, empty secondary prefix (new secondary every repetition), secondary already holds (nothing transfer).
code: env <- cloud[1, grep("^env_", names(cloud))] knitr::kable(data.frame(   item = sub("^env_", "", names(env)),   value = vapply(env, function(v) as.character(v[[1]]), character(1)),   row.names = NULL )) root <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("RCS_BENCH_ROOT", "."), winslash = "/") devtools::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE) source(file.path(root, "bench", "harness.R")) results_dir <- file.path(root, "bench", "results") rlang::check_installed(c("h3o", "bench", "gargle", "httr2")) gcs_root <- Sys.getenv("RCS_TEST_GCS", "") if (!nzchar(gcs_root)) {   cli::cli_abort("Set {.envvar RCS_TEST_GCS} to a test bucket; this benchmark needs one.") } n_table <- 1e6 n_polygons <- 1e5 n_small <- 98 work <- file.path(tempdir(), "rcs-bench-cloud") unlink(work, recursive = TRUE) local_root <- file.path(work, "store") gcs_uri <- paste0(   sub("/+$", "", gcs_root), "/bench-",   substr(md5_string(paste(Sys.time(), stats::runif(1))), 1, 10), "/store" ) options(rcs.quiet = TRUE) env <- bench_env(storage = "gcs") env$commit <- tryCatch(   system2("git", c("-C", root, "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"), stdout = TRUE),   error = function(e) NA_character_ ) # The local store, then its files copied one by one to the bucket with the # package's own upload (`be_put()`), so that every object carries its MD5. build_stores <- function() {   st <- store_connect(local_root, create = TRUE)   for (i in seq_len(n_small)) {     store_write(st, rcs_sim_table(200, seed = i), sprintf("small/t%03d", i),       title = sprintf("Small table %d", i), description = "Simulated daily sales, a small sample.",       key = c("shop_id", "date", "product")     )   }   store_write(st, rcs_sim_table(n_table, seed = 1), "sales/daily",     title = "Daily sales", description = "Simulated daily sales.",     key = c("shop_id", "date", "product"), partition = "year"   )   store_write(st, rcs_sim_polygons(n_polygons, seed = 1), "shapes/polygons",     title = "Polygons", description = "Simulated polygons in open ocean."   )   local <- be_new(local_root)   remote <- be_new(gcs_uri)   listing <- be_list(local)   for (p in listing$path) {     with_retry(function() be_put(remote, file.path(local_root, p), p))   }   list(datasets = nrow(st$primary$catalog), bytes = sum(listing$bytes), objects = nrow(listing)) } # Cold: the Arrow file system and the access token are created again (as in # a new R session); warm: both are reused. connect_cases <- function() {   rbind(     bench_run(connect_local = store_connect(local_root), case = "connect"),     bench_run(       connect_gcs_cold = store_connect(gcs_uri), case = "connect", run = "cold",       setup = quote(gcs_reset_clients())     ),     bench_run(connect_gcs_warm = store_connect(gcs_uri), case = "connect")   ) } # Streaming: `store_read()` on the bucket. Download: the dataset's files # fetched whole (`be_get()`) into an empty folder; the local read of the # copy is timed separately, so download-then-read is the sum of the two. download <- function(be, paths) {   for (p in paths) be_get(be, p, file.path(dl_dir, p)) }  read_cases <- function(st_gcs, st_local) {   be_gcs <- st_gcs$primary$backend   files <- st_gcs$primary$files   sales <- files$path[files$dataset == "sales/daily"]   sales_2025 <- files$path[files$dataset == "sales/daily" & grepl('"year":2025', files$partition_values, fixed = TRUE)]   polygons <- files$path[files$dataset == "shapes/polygons"]   fresh <- quote(unlink(dl_dir, recursive = TRUE))   rbind(     bench_run(stream = store_read(st_gcs, "sales/daily"), case = "sales full"),     bench_run(download = download(be_gcs, sales), case = "sales full", setup = fresh),     bench_run(local = store_read(st_local, "sales/daily"), case = "sales full"),     bench_run(       stream = store_read(st_gcs, "sales/daily", year == 2025L, columns = c(shop_id, date, qty)),       case = "sales year and columns"     ),     bench_run(download = download(be_gcs, sales_2025), case = "sales year and columns", setup = fresh),     bench_run(       local = store_read(st_local, "sales/daily", year == 2025L, columns = c(shop_id, date, qty)),       case = "sales year and columns"     ),     bench_run(stream = store_read(st_gcs, "shapes/polygons"), case = "polygons full"),     bench_run(download = download(be_gcs, polygons), case = "polygons full", setup = fresh),     bench_run(local = store_read(st_local, "shapes/polygons"), case = "polygons full")   ) } # MD5 of the stored files: from object metadata on the bucket, by hashing # the files locally; and the integrity check, which adds the Parquet footers. md5_cases <- function(st_gcs, st_local) {   files <- st_gcs$primary$files   sales <- files$path[files$dataset == "sales/daily"]   rbind(     bench_run(gcs = be_md5(st_gcs$primary$backend, sales), case = "md5 of sales files"),     bench_run(local = be_md5(st_local$primary$backend, sales), case = "md5 of sales files"),     bench_run(gcs = store_check(st_gcs, "sales/daily"), case = "check sales"),     bench_run(local = store_check(st_local, "sales/daily"), case = "check sales")   ) } # A new secondary for every repetition of the sync to an empty location. sync_cases <- function() {   sync_root <- paste0(sub("/store$", "", gcs_uri), "/sync-")   state <- new.env()   state$i <- 0L   fresh_secondary <- rlang::expr({     i <- i + 1L     st_sync <- store_connect(local_root, secondary = paste0(!!sync_root, i), create = TRUE)   })   empty <- bench_run(     sync_empty = store_sync(st_sync, datasets = "shapes/polygons"),     case = "sync polygons", setup = fresh_secondary, env = state   )   st_same <- store_connect(local_root, secondary = paste0(sync_root, "same"), create = TRUE)   store_sync(st_same, datasets = "shapes/polygons")   same <- bench_run(sync_identical = store_sync(st_same, datasets = "shapes/polygons"), case = "sync polygons")   rbind(empty, same) } remove_gcs_prefix <- function() {   be <- be_new(sub("/store$", "", gcs_uri))   left <- tryCatch(be_list(be), error = function(e) NULL)   if (!is.null(left) && nrow(left) > 0) be_delete(be, left$path)   cli::cli_inform("Removed {if (is.null(left)) 0 else nrow(left)} object{?s} under the benchmark prefix.") }  dl_dir <- file.path(work, "download") run_all <- function() {   cli::cli_inform("Building the stores.")   built <- build_stores()   st_local <- store_connect(local_root)   st_gcs <- store_connect(gcs_uri)   cli::cli_inform("Timing connect.")   timed <- connect_cases()   cli::cli_inform("Timing reads.")   timed <- rbind(timed, read_cases(st_gcs, st_local))   cli::cli_inform("Timing MD5 and checks.")   timed <- rbind(timed, md5_cases(st_gcs, st_local))   cli::cli_inform("Timing sync.")   timed <- rbind(timed, sync_cases())   counted <- counter_cases(st_gcs, st_local)   timed$datasets <- built$datasets   timed$store_bytes <- built$bytes   timed$store_objects <- built$objects   sales <- st_local$primary$files[st_local$primary$files$dataset == "sales/daily", ]   timed$sales_bytes <- sum(sales$bytes)   timed$sales_files <- nrow(sales)   list(timed = timed, counted = counted) }  out <- tryCatch(run_all(), finally = remove_gcs_prefix()) bench_save(out$timed, "cloud", env = env, dir = results_dir) bench_save(out$counted, "cloud-counters", env = env, dir = results_dir) unlink(work, recursive = TRUE)

title: Benchmark: H3 package and the cost of geocoding
text: Simulated polygons (rcs_sim_polygons(), open ocean, 10% built across cell edges), resolution 5. operation timed bench_run() (least five repetitions, median reported).
code: env <- backends[1, grep("^env_", names(backends))] knitr::kable(data.frame(   item = sub("^env_", "", names(env)),   value = vapply(env, function(v) as.character(v[[1]]), character(1)),   row.names = NULL )) root <- Sys.getenv("RCS_BENCH_ROOT", ".") devtools::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE) source(file.path(root, "bench", "harness.R")) results_dir <- file.path(root, "bench", "results") rlang::check_installed(c("h3o", "h3jsr", "bench")) sizes <- as.numeric(strsplit(Sys.getenv("RCS_BENCH_SIZES", "1e5;1e6"), ";")[[1]]) res <- 5L env <- bench_env(storage = "ssd") env$commit <- tryCatch(   system2("git", c("-C", root, "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"), stdout = TRUE),   error = function(e) NA_character_ ) # Corners of the boxes, the crossing rows and their cells, for one size. prepare <- function(n) {   x <- rcs_sim_polygons(n, seed = 1)   g <- sf::st_geometry(x)   box <- geo_envelope(g)   keep <- !is.na(box$xmin)   corners <- data.frame(     x = c(box$xmin, box$xmin, box$xmax, box$xmax)[rep(keep, 4)],     y = c(box$ymin, box$ymax, box$ymax, box$ymin)[rep(keep, 4)]   )   first <- h3_hex_of_points(box$xmin, box$ymin, res)   third <- h3_hex_of_points(box$xmax, box$ymax, res)   crossing <- which(keep & first != third)   polygons <- sf::st_cast(g[crossing], "MULTIPOLYGON")   cells <- unique(unlist(geo_touched_hex(geo_wkb(g[crossing]), res)))   list(x = x, corners = corners, polygons = polygons, cells = cells) } # Cell of every box corner: the bulk of geocoding (four points per row). corners_h3o <- function(d) as.character(h3o::h3_from_xy(d$corners$y, d$corners$x, res)) corners_h3jsr <- function(d) h3jsr::point_to_cell(d$corners, res = res) # Cells whose centre is inside each crossing polygon (the mode both offer). polyfill_h3o <- function(d) h3o::sfc_to_cells(d$polygons, res, "centroid") polyfill_h3jsr <- function(d) h3jsr::polygon_to_cells(d$polygons, res = res) # Cell polygons, for the intersections with the crossing rows. boundaries_h3o <- function(d) sf::st_as_sfc(h3o::h3_from_strings(d$cells)) boundaries_h3jsr <- function(d) h3jsr::cell_to_polygon(d$cells) # The whole encoding with the chosen package (h3o), per row. encode <- function(d) geo_encode(d$x, h3_res = res) rows <- list() for (n in sizes) {   case <- format(n, scientific = TRUE)   cli::cli_inform("Preparing {case} polygons.")   d <- prepare(n)   cli::cli_inform("Timing {case} polygons.")   agree <- identical(corners_h3o(d), corners_h3jsr(d))   timed <- bench_run(     corners_h3o = corners_h3o(d),     corners_h3jsr = corners_h3jsr(d),     polyfill_h3o = polyfill_h3o(d),     polyfill_h3jsr = polyfill_h3jsr(d),     boundaries_h3o = boundaries_h3o(d),     boundaries_h3jsr = boundaries_h3jsr(d),     encode_h3o = encode(d),     case = case   )   timed$rows <- n   timed$points <- c(rep(nrow(d$corners), 2), rep(length(d$polygons), 2), rep(length(d$cells), 2), n)   timed$corners_agree <- agree   rows[[case]] <- timed   rm(d)   gc() } backends <- do.call(rbind, rows) backends$us_per_item <- 1e6 * backends$median_s / backends$points bench_save(backends, "h3-backends", env = env, dir = results_dir)

title: Benchmark: H3 package and the cost of geocoding
text: points counts items operation: box corners, crossing polygons, distinct cells, rows encode_h3o. packages return cell every corner: corners_agree TRUE every case. Inside rows, remedy:
code: shown <- backends[c("case", "expression", "points", "median_s", "min_s", "max_s", "us_per_item")] shown$median_s <- signif(shown$median_s, 3) shown$min_s <- signif(shown$min_s, 3) shown$max_s <- signif(shown$max_s, 3) shown$us_per_item <- signif(shown$us_per_item, 3) knitr::kable(shown) ratio <- function(case, op) {   rows <- backends[backends$case == case, ]   rows$median_s[rows$expression == paste0(op, "_h3jsr")] /     rows$median_s[rows$expression == paste0(op, "_h3o")] } speedup <- expand.grid(case = unique(backends$case), operation = c("corners", "polyfill", "boundaries"),   stringsAsFactors = FALSE) speedup$h3jsr_over_h3o <- round(mapply(ratio, speedup$case, speedup$operation), 1) knitr::kable(speedup) knitr::kable(inside[c("lat", "width_km", "boxes", "inside", "violations", "inside_after_remedy", "violations_after_remedy")]) # Random boxes; those whose four corners share a cell are inside rows. Their # boundary, taken at 64 points per edge (parallels and meridians, where a # vertex of the row may lie), is checked for points in another cell, before # and after the package's remedy (extra points along the edge nearest the # equator, `geo_edge_points()`). measure_inside <- function(n, lat, width_km, seed, k = 64) {   box <- withr::with_seed(seed, {     cy <- stats::runif(n, lat - 1, lat + 1)     cx <- stats::runif(n, -170, 170)     w <- width_km / (111.32 * cos(cy * pi / 180))     h <- width_km / 110.574 * stats::runif(n, 0.3, 1)     list(xmin = cx - w / 2, xmax = cx + w / 2, ymin = cy - h / 2, ymax = cy + h / 2)   })   corner <- function(x, y) h3_hex_of_points(x, y, res)   c1 <- corner(box$xmin, box$ymin)   inside <- which(     c1 == corner(box$xmin, box$ymax) & c1 == corner(box$xmax, box$ymax) & c1 == corner(box$xmax, box$ymin)   )   e <- lapply(box, `[`, inside)   m <- length(inside)   t <- seq(0, 1, length.out = k)   along_x <- outer(e$xmin, rep(1, k)) + outer(e$xmax - e$xmin, t)   along_y <- outer(e$ymin, rep(1, k)) + outer(e$ymax - e$ymin, t)   px <- cbind(along_x, along_x, matrix(e$xmin, m, k), matrix(e$xmax, m, k))   py <- cbind(matrix(e$ymin, m, k), matrix(e$ymax, m, k), along_y, along_y)   cells <- matrix(h3_hex_of_points(c(px), c(py), res), m)   violation <- rowSums(cells != c1[inside]) > 0   edge <- geo_edge_points(e)   kept <- rep(TRUE, m)   if (length(edge$row) > 0) {     off <- h3_hex_of_points(edge$x, edge$y, res) != c1[inside][edge$row]     kept[unique(edge$row[off])] <- FALSE   }   data.frame(     lat = lat, width_km = width_km, boxes = n, inside = m,     violations = sum(violation), inside_after_remedy = sum(kept),     violations_after_remedy = sum(violation & kept)   ) }  grid <- expand.grid(width_km = c(0.5, 2, 8, 15), lat = c(5, 30, 60, 80, 85)) inside_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {   cli::cli_inform("Inside rows: latitude {grid$lat[[i]]}, {grid$width_km[[i]]} km.")   measure_inside(20000, grid$lat[[i]], grid$width_km[[i]], seed = i) })) bench_save(inside_rows, "h3-inside-rows", env = env, dir = results_dir)

key = key ) store_write(st, sales, "sales/by_year",   title = "Daily sales by year", description = "Simulated daily sales.", key = key, partition = "year" ) store_write(st, rcs_sim_polygons(n, seed = 1), "shapes/polygons",   title = "Polygons", description = "Simulated polygons in open ocean." ) rm(sales) gc()  # Absolute paths of a dataset's files, from the catalog; `year` of each file # for the partitioned table. files_of <- function(dataset) {   rows <- st$primary$files[st$primary$files$dataset == dataset, ]   file.path(work, rows$path) } year_file <- function(dataset, year) {   rows <- st$primary$files[st$primary$files$dataset == dataset, ]   keep <- grepl(paste0('"year":', year), rows$partition_values, fixed = TRUE)   file.path(work, rows$path[keep]) } polygon_crs <- sf::st_crs(st$primary$catalog$crs[st$primary$catalog$dataset == "shapes/polygons"]) # Arrow only: each file read whole and bound, or one dataset over the list. read_files <- function(paths, ...) {   parts <- lapply(paths, function(p) arrow::read_parquet(p, ...))   if (length(parts) == 1) parts[[1]] else vctrs::vec_rbind(!!!parts) } open_files <- function(paths) arrow::open_dataset(paths, format = "parquet") as_sf <- function(data) {   data$geometry <- sf::st_as_sfc(structure(data$geometry, class = "WKB"), crs = polygon_crs)   sf::st_as_sf(data) } # Each operation as the three (or four) methods; same rows, same columns. operations <- function(dataset) {   paths <- files_of(dataset)   ops <- list(     full = list(       store = quote(store_read(st, dataset)),       arrow_read_parquet = quote(read_files(paths)),       arrow_open_dataset = quote(dplyr::collect(open_files(paths)))     ),     columns = list(       store = quote(store_read(st, dataset, columns = c(shop_id, date, qty))),       arrow_read_parquet = quote(read_files(paths, col_select = c("shop_id", "date", "qty"))),       arrow_open_dataset = quote(dplyr::collect(dplyr::select(open_files(paths), shop_id, date, peak_wset_before_bytes = before[["peak_wset"]],       peak_wset_after_bytes = after[["peak_wset"]],       staging_peak_bytes = w$peak_stage,       !!!w$value     )     cli::cli_inform("{kind} code: env <- timed[1, grep("^env_", names(timed))] knitr::kable(data.frame(   item = sub("^env_", "", names(env)),   value = vapply(env, function(v) as.character(v[[1]]), character(1)),   row.names = NULL )) shown <- layouts[c("rows", "layout", "partition", "h3_res", "rows_per_group", "sort", "write_s", "files", "row_groups", "data_bytes", "index_rows", "index_bytes")] shown$data_mb <- round(shown$data_bytes / 1e6, 1) shown$index_mb <- round(shown$index_bytes / 1e6, 1) shown$data_bytes <- shown$index_bytes <- NULL shown$write_s <- round(shown$write_s) knitr::kable(shown[order(shown$rows, shown$layout), ], row.names = FALSE, format.args = list(big.mark = ",")) root <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("RCS_BENCH_ROOT", "."), winslash = "/") devtools::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE) source(file.path(root, "bench", "harness.R")) results_dir <- Sys.getenv("RCS_BENCH_RESULTS", file.path(root, "bench", "results")) rlang::check_installed(c("h3o", "bench", "duckdb", "DBI")) n <- as.numeric(Sys.getenv("RCS_BENCH_SIZES", "1e6")) gcs_root <- Sys.getenv("RCS_TEST_GCS", "") work <- file.path(tempdir(), "rcs-bench-spatial") unlink(work, recursive = TRUE) dir.create(work, recursive = TRUE) options(rcs.quiet = TRUE, rcs.workers = 1) sf::sf_use_s2(TRUE) dataset <- "shapes/polygons" instances <- 5L env <- bench_env(storage = "ssd") env$commit <- tryCatch(   system2("git", c("-C", root, "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"), stdout = TRUE),   error = function(e) NA_character_ ) # `sort = "fine"`: inside each `h3` cell, rows are ordered by the cell of # their box centre at `h3_res + 3` (see `fine_sort()`). layouts <- tibble::tribble(   ~layout,        ~partition, ~h3_res, ~rows_per_group, ~sort,   "base",         FALSE,      5L,      50000L,          "h3",   "part",         TRUE,       5L,      50000L,          "h3",   "res4",         FALSE,      4L,      50000L,          "h3",   "res4_part",    TRUE,       4L,      50000L,          "h3",   "res6",         FALSE,      6L,      50000L,          "h3",   "res6_part",    TRUE,       6L,      50000L,          "h3",   "rg2e4",        FALSE,      5L,      20000L,          "h3",   "rg1e5",        FALSE,      5L,      100000L,         "h3",   "fine",         FALSE,      5L,      50000L,          "fine" ) # res4_part and res6_part are not run by default: the partition resolution # is the finest at or below `h3_res` with at most `max_files` files, the # same for `h3_res` 4, 5 and 6 on these data, so the files are those of # `part` default_layouts <- if (n <= 1e6) c("base", "part", "res4", "res6", "rg2e4", "rg1e5", "fine") else c("base", "part") chosen <- strsplit(Sys.getenv("RCS_BENCH_LAYOUTS", paste(default_layouts, collapse = ";")), ";")[[1]] on_gcs <- strsplit(Sys.getenv("RCS_BENCH_GCS", ""), ";")[[1]] if (length(on_gcs) > 0 && !nzchar(gcs_root)) {   cli::cli_abort("Set {.envvar RCS_TEST_GCS} to time layouts on GCS.") }  # Written order with a finer cell inside `h3`: wraps `geo_encode()` for the # duration of one write. The rows are put in the order (h3, cell of the box # centre at h3_res + 3, previous order); `.rcs_id` is given again in that # order and the index rows follow their rows. The finer cell is only a sort # key; nothing about it is stored. fine_sort <- function(encoded, h3_res) {   data <- encoded$data   box <- data$bbox   cx <- (box$xmin + box$xmax) / 2   cy <- (box$ymin + box$ymax) / 2   fine <- rep(bit64::NA_integer64_, nrow(data))   ok <- !is.na(cx)   if (any(ok)) {     points <- sf::st_as_sfc(wk::xy(cx[ok], cy[ok], crs = 4326))     fine[ok] <- h3_as_int64(h3o::h3_from_points(points, min(15L, h3_res + 3L)))   }   order <- vctrs::vec_order(     data.frame(h3 = as.character(data$h3), fine = as.character(fine), row = seq_len(nrow(data))),     na_value = "largest"   )   # the cells of one resolution have the same number of digits, so their   # decimal strings sort like the integers   first <- min(data$.rcs_id)   old_ids <- data$.rcs_id[order]   data <- data[order, , drop = FALSE]   data$.rcs_id <- first + bit64::as.integer64(seq_len(nrow(data)) - 1L)   if (!is.null(encoded$index) && nrow(encoded$index) > 0) {     index <- encoded$index     index$.rcs_id <- data$.rcs_id[match(as.character(index$.rcs_id), as.character(old_ids))]     index <- index[order(as.character(index$h3), as.numeric(index$.rcs_id)), , drop = FALSE]     encoded$index <- index   }   encoded$data <- data   encoded }  with_fine_sort <- function(code) {   ns <- asNamespace("rcs")   original <- get("geo_encode", envir = ns)   wrapped <- function(x, h3_res = 5L, ...) fine_sort(original(x, h3_res = h3_res, ...), h3_res)   unlockBinding("geo_encode", ns)   assign("geo_encode", wrapped, envir = ns)   on.exit({     assign("geo_encode", original, envir = ns)     lockBinding("geo_encode", ns)   })   force(code) } # Five instances of each query type, the same for every layout of a size. # Cells are given as hex strings; polygons are irregular 16-gons around a # random centre, radius about 0.01, 0.1 or 0.5 degrees. make_queries <- function(seed = 7) {   withr::with_seed(seed, {     out <- list()     for (res in 3:9) {       x <- stats::runif(instances, -29.9, -24.1)       y <- stats::runif(instances, 6.1, 8.9)       cells <- h3o::h3_from_points(sf::st_as_sfc(wk::xy(x, y, crs = 4326)), res)       out[[paste0("cell", res)]] <- as.list(as.character(cells))     }     for (size in c(small = 0.01, medium = 0.1, large = 0.5)) {       shapes <- lapply(seq_len(instances), function(i) {         cx <- stats::runif(1, -29.4, -24.6)         cy <- stats::runif(1, 6.6, 8.4)         a <- sort(stats::runif(16, 0, 2 * pi))         r <- size * stats::runif(16, 0.6, 1)         xy <- cbind(cx + r * cos(a), cy + r * sin(a))         sf::st_sfc(sf::st_polygon(list(rbind(xy, xy[1, ]))), crs = 4326)       })       out[[paste0("poly_", names(which(c(small = 0.01, medium = 0.1, large = 0.5) == size)))]] <- shapes     }     # diagonal strips 2 degrees long, 0.01 (strip) or 0.2 (band) degrees     # wide, whose box is much larger than the shape; added after the first     # runs at 1e6 rows     strip <- function(half_width) {       lapply(seq_len(instances), function(i) {         cx <- stats::runif(1, -28, -26)         cy <- stats::runif(1, 7, 8)         a <- stats::runif(1, pi / 8, 3 * pi / 8)         along <- c(cos(a), sin(a))         across <- c(-sin(a), cos(a))         w <- half_width * across         corners <- rbind(c(cx, cy) - along - w, c(cx, cy) + along - w, c(cx, cy) + along + w, c(cx, cy) - along + w)         sf::st_sfc(sf::st_polygon(list(rbind(corners, corners[1, ]))), crs = 4326)       })     }     if (strips) {       out$poly_strip <- strip(0.005)       out$poly_band <- strip(0.1)     }     out   }) } strips <- n > 1e6 || nzchar(Sys.getenv("RCS_BENCH_STRIPS")) queries <- make_queries() query_types <- names(queries) # The query shapes as the package tests them (cell polygons; polygons as # given), in EPSG:4326, for the comparisons. query_shape <- function(y) geo_covering(y, 5L, sf::st_crs(4326)$wkt)$shape shapes <- lapply(queries, lapply, query_shape) # The steps of the spatial filter, each switched on or off. `prune`: drop # files by their box (and, with cells, their h3 range); `cells`: the cell # test on `h3`; `index`: add the rows of the index table (`.rcs_id`); # `bbox`: the box test pushed into the scan; `exact`: `sf::st_intersects()` # in `collect()`. `default` is `store_read(intersects = )` itself; until # this benchmark it was `cells_index_bbox` for every query, since then it is # `bbox_only` unless the query's box is much larger than the query (see # `spatial_use_cells()`); the column `default_rule` of the results says # which ("box first" since the change, missing before). flags <- function(prune, cells, index, bbox, exact = TRUE) {   list(prune = prune, cells = cells, index = index, bbox = bbox, exact = exact) } variants <- list(   default = NULL,   cells_index_bbox = flags(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE),   no_bbox = flags(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE),   no_prune = flags(FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE),   no_index = flags(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE),   candidates = flags(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, exact = FALSE),   bbox_only = flags(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE),   bbox_no_prune = flags(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE),   cells_only = flags(FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE),   prune_only = flags(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE) ) gcs_variants <- strsplit(Sys.getenv("RCS_BENCH_GCS_VARIANTS", "default;cells_index_bbox;no_prune;bbox_only"), ";")[[1]] # Layouts other than `base` and `part` are timed in these variants only. short_variants <- c("default", "cells_index_bbox", "bbox_only") # Variants timed on `base` and `part`: RCS_BENCH_VARIANTS (default all; at # 5e6 rows fewer, see the article). full_variants <- strsplit(Sys.getenv("RCS_BENCH_VARIANTS", paste(names(variants), collapse = ";")), ";")[[1]]  # Combinations whose counters are taken: file pruning by row filter. row_filters <- list(   none = c(cells = FALSE, index = FALSE, bbox = FALSE),   bbox = c(cells = FALSE, index = FALSE, bbox = TRUE),   cells = c(cells = TRUE, index = FALSE, bbox = FALSE),   cells_index = c(cells = TRUE, index = TRUE, bbox = FALSE),   cells_bbox = c(cells = TRUE, index = FALSE, bbox = TRUE),   cells_index_bbox = c(cells = TRUE, index = TRUE, bbox = TRUE) )  # One query in one variant, from the package's internal steps (the same # functions `store_read()` uses). Returns what `store_read()` returns; with # `ids_only` the column `id` of the candidate rows, without geometry. run_variant <- function(st, y, v, ids_only = FALSE) {   if (is.null(v)) {     return(store_read(st, dataset, intersects = y))   }   target <- read_target(st, dataset)   entry <- target$entry   location <- target$location   covering <- geo_covering(y, entry$h3_res, entry$crs)   cells <- if (v$cells) covering$cells   ids <- NULL   if (v$cells && v$index) {     ids <- spatial_index_rows(c(list(store = st), target[c("entry", "location", "files")]), cells)   }   test <- list(     shape = covering$shape, exact = v$exact && !ids_only, bbox = if (v$bbox) covering$bbox,     cells = cells, ids = ids$.rcs_id, geographic = TRUE   )   files <- target$files   if (v$prune) {     by <- list(bbox = covering$bbox, cells = cells, geographic = TRUE)     files <- files[spatial_keep_files(files, by, ids$h3_main), ]   }   schema <- if (nrow(files) == 0) query_open_files(location, target$files$path[[1]])$schema   source <- query_open_files(location, files$path, schema = schema)   q <- new_query(st, entry, location, files, dplyr::select(source, dplyr::everything()))   predicate <- spatial_predicate(test)   if (!is.null(predicate)) q <- query_bottom_filter(q, predicate)   q$spatial <- list(tests = list(test), cells = length(cells), index = length(ids) > 0)   if (ids_only) {     q$geometry <- FALSE     q$query <- dplyr::select(q$query, "id")   }   query_collect(q) } duckdb_sql <- function(paths, shape) {   b <- sf::st_bbox(shape)   wkt <- sf::st_as_text(sf::st_geometry(shape)[[1]])   sprintf(     paste(       "SELECT id, area, cat, h3, bbox, ST_AsWKB(geometry) AS geometry",       "FROM read_parquet([%s])",       "WHERE bbox.xmin <= %.17g AND bbox.xmax >= %.17g AND bbox.ymin <= %.17g AND bbox.ymax >= %.17g",       "AND ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('%s'))"     ),     paste0("'", paths, "'", collapse = ", "), b[["xmax"]], b[["xmin"]], b[["ymax"]], b[["ymin"]], wkt   ) } # The counter `row_groups_overlap` reads the `h3`, `.rcs_id` and `bbox` # values of every row group for every query; here each row group is read # once per file and reduced to three rows (the minima, the maxima and the # widest box), which give the same answer in `row_group_overlaps()`. overlap_cache <- new.env() row_group_stats <- function(fs, path) {   key <- paste0(fs$path, "/", path)   if (!is.null(overlap_cache[[key]])) {     return(overlap_cache[[key]])   }   file <- fs$fs$OpenInputFile(key)   on.exit(file$close())   reader <- arrow::ParquetFileReader$create(file)   schema <- reader$GetSchema()   columns <- intersect(c("h3", ".rcs_id", "bbox"), names(schema))   leaves <- parquet_leaf_indices(schema, columns)   low <- function(v) if (all(is.na(v))) v[1] else min(v, na.rm = TRUE)   high <- function(v) if (all(is.na(v))) v[1] else max(v, na.rm = TRUE)   out <- lapply(seq_len(reader$num_row_groups) - 1L, function(g) {     s <- withr::with_options(list(arrow.int64_downcast = FALSE), as.data.frame(reader$ReadRowGroup(g, leaves)))     widest <- which.max(s$bbox$xmax - s$bbox$xmin)     if (length(widest) == 0) widest <- 1L     three <- s[c(1L, 1L, widest), , drop = FALSE]     for (col in setdiff(names(s), "bbox")) {       three[[col]][1:2] <- c(low(s[[col]]), high(s[[col]]))     }     for (col in names(s$bbox)) {       three$bbox[[col]][1:2] <- c(low(s$bbox[[col]]), high(s$bbox[[col]]))     }     three   })   overlap_cache[[key]] <- out   out } cached_overlap <- function(q) {   fs <- be_arrow_fs(q$location$backend)   tests <- q$spatial$tests   total <- 0   for (path in q$files$path) {     for (stats in row_group_stats(fs, path)) {       if (all(vapply(tests, row_group_overlaps, logical(1), stats = stats))) total <- total + 1     }   }   total } local({   ns <- asNamespace("rcs")   unlockBinding("spatial_row_groups_overlap", ns)   assign("spatial_row_groups_overlap", cached_overlap, envir = ns) })  counters_of <- function(st, y, v) {   out <- NULL   counters <- bench_counters(out <- run_variant(st, y, v, ids_only = TRUE))   n_of <- function(counter, pattern = NULL) {     keep <- counters$counter == counter     if (!is.null(pattern)) keep <- keep & grepl(pattern, counters$detail)     sum(counters$n[keep])   }   list(     ids = out$id,     files_data = n_of("file_open", "^shapes/polygons/"),     files_index = n_of("file_open", "__h3/"),     row_groups_total = n_of("row_groups_total"),     row_groups_overlap = n_of("row_groups_overlap"),     rows_candidate = nrow(out)   ) }  # Time one query type: one instance per repetition, chosen in `setup`; # `expr_of(y, shape)` gets the query as given and its shape. time_type <- function(expr_of, qtype, label, case, run = "warm", reconnect = NULL) {   state <- new.env()   state$k <- 0L   state$expr_of <- expr_of   setup <- rlang::expr({     k <- k %% !!instances + 1L     y <- queries[[!!qtype]][[k]]     s <- shapes[[!!qtype]][[k]]     !!reconnect   })   row <- rlang::inject(bench_run(!!label := expr_of(y, s), case = case, run = run, setup = setup, env = state))   row$query <- qtype   row }  layout_facts <- function(st) {   files <- st$primary$files   data <- files[files$dataset == dataset, ]   index <- files[files$dataset == index_name(dataset), ]   groups <- files_row_groups(st$primary$backend, data$path)   tibble::tibble(     files = nrow(data), row_groups = nrow(groups), data_bytes = sum(as.numeric(data$bytes)),     index_files = nrow(index), index_rows = sum(as.numeric(index$rows)),     index_bytes = sum(as.numeric(index$bytes))   ) } save_merged <- function(new_rows, name) {   if (is.null(new_rows) || nrow(new_rows) == 0) {     return(invisible())   }   path <- file.path(results_dir, paste0(name, ".parquet"))   tagged <- env   names(tagged) <- paste0("env_", names(tagged))   new_rows <- cbind(tibble::as_tibble(new_rows), tagged[rep(1L, nrow(new_rows)), ])   if (file.exists(path)) {     old <- tibble::as_tibble(arrow::read_parquet(path, mmap = FALSE))     replaced <- paste(old$rows, old$layout, old$location) %in% paste(new_rows$rows, new_rows$layout, new_rows$location)     old <- old[!replaced, ]     new_rows <- vctrs::vec_rbind(old, new_rows)   }   arrow::write_parquet(tibble::as_tibble(new_rows), path)   cli::cli_inform("Saved {nrow(new_rows)} rows to {.path {path}}.") } x <- rcs_sim_polygons(n, seed = 1) gc()  run_layout <- function(spec) {   name <- spec$layout   uri <- file.path(work, name)   st <- store_connect(uri, create = TRUE)   cli::cli_inform("Layout {name}: writing {format(n, big.mark = ',')} polygons.")   write <- function() {     store_write(st, x, dataset,       title = "Polygons", description = "Simulated polygons in open ocean.",       partition = if (spec$partition) "h3", h3_res = spec$h3_res,       rows_per_group = spec$rows_per_group, check = FALSE     )   }   start <- bench::hires_time()   if (spec$sort == "fine") with_fine_sort(write()) else write()   write_s <- as.numeric(bench::hires_time() - start)   if (identical(name, chosen[[length(chosen)]])) {     # the data are not needed after the last write; free the memory     rm(x, envir = globalenv())     gc()   }   facts <- tibble::tibble(rows = n, layout = name, location = "local", !!!spec[-1], write_s = write_s, layout_facts(st))   st <- store_connect(uri)   part <- spec$partition    # counters and completeness   cli::cli_inform("Layout {name}: counters.")   counted <- list()   reference <- list()   for (qtype in query_types) {     for (k in seq_len(instances)) {       y <- queries[[qtype]][[k]]       truth <- sort(store_read(st, dataset, intersects = y, columns = id, geometry = TRUE)$id)       reference[[paste(qtype, k)]] <- truth       # with one file, pruning changes nothing but an empty result       for (prune in if (part) c(TRUE, FALSE) else TRUE) {         for (rf in names(row_filters)) {           f <- row_filters[[rf]]           v <- flags(prune, f[["cells"]], f[["index"]], f[["bbox"]], exact = FALSE)           cnt <- counters_of(st, y, v)           counted[[length(counted) + 1L]] <- tibble::tibble(             query = qtype, instance = k, prune = prune, row_filter = rf,             files_data = cnt$files_data, files_index = cnt$files_index,             row_groups_total = cnt$row_groups_total, row_groups_overlap = cnt$row_groups_overlap,             rows_candidate = cnt$rows_candidate, rows_returned = length(truth),             missing = sum(!truth %in% cnt$ids),             returned_md5 = md5_string(paste(truth, collapse = ","))           )         }       }     }   }   counted <- do.call(rbind, counted)   counted <- tibble::tibble(rows = n, layout = name, location = "local", counted)    # times   cli::cli_inform("Layout {name}: times.")   timed <- list()   add <- function(row, variant, complete) {     row$variant <- variant     row$complete <- complete     timed[[length(timed) + 1L]] <<- row   }   for (vname in names(variants)) {     if (vname == "prune_only" && !part) next     if (!name %in% c("base", "part") && !vname %in% short_variants) next     if (name %in% c("base", "part") && !vname %in% full_variants) next     v <- variants[[vname]]     complete <- !identical(vname, "no_index")     for (qtype in query_types) {       add(time_type(function(y, s) run_variant(st, y, v), qtype, vname, name), vname, complete)     }   }   # DuckDB on the same files, local only   con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())   on.exit(DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE), add = TRUE)   DBI::dbExecute(con, "LOAD spatial")   paths <- file.path(uri, st$primary$files$path[st$primary$files$dataset == dataset])   duck_rows <- list()   for (qtype in query_types) {     for (k in seq_len(instances)) {       got <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, duckdb_sql(paths, shapes[[qtype]][[k]]))$id       truth <- reference[[paste(qtype, k)]]       duck_rows[[length(duck_rows) + 1L]] <- tibble::tibble(         query = qtype, instance = k, rows_duckdb = length(got),         duckdb_missing = sum(!truth %in% got), duckdb_extra = sum(!got %in% truth)       )     }     add(time_type(function(y, s) DBI::dbGetQuery(con, duckdb_sql(paths, s)), qtype, "duckdb", name), "duckdb", NA)   }   duck_rows <- do.call(rbind, duck_rows)   counted <- merge(counted, duck_rows, by = c("query", "instance"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)   # read everything, then sf::st_filter(), on the base layouts   if (name %in% c("base")) {     cli::cli_inform("Layout {name}: read everything, then filter.")     add(bench_run(read_all = store_read(st, dataset), case = name), "read_all", TRUE)     timed[[length(timed)]]$query <- NA_character_     all <- store_read(st, dataset)     hits <- list()     # one filter of 1e6 rows takes about 40 s (s2); above 1e6 rows only the     # read of everything is timed, which alone exceeds the spatial reads     filter_types <- if (n <= 1e6) query_types else character()     for (qtype in filter_types) {       add(time_type(function(y, s) sf::st_filter(all, s), qtype, "st_filter", name), "st_filter", TRUE)       for (k in seq_len(instances)) {         got <- sort(sf::st_filter(all, shapes[[qtype]][[k]])$id)         hits[[paste(qtype, k)]] <- identical(got, reference[[paste(qtype, k)]])       }     }     if (length(hits) > 0) {       facts$st_filter_identical <- sum(unlist(hits))       facts$st_filter_compared <- length(hits)     }     rm(all)     gc()   }   timed <- do.call(vctrs::vec_rbind, timed)   timed <- tibble::tibble(rows = n, layout = name, location = "local", timed)   timed$default_rule <- if (exists("spatial_use_cells", asNamespace("rcs"))) "box first" else NA_character_    # GCS, cold   if (name %in% on_gcs) {     cli::cli_inform("Layout {name}: GCS.")     prefix <- paste0(sub("/+$", "", gcs_root), "/spatial-", substr(md5_string(paste(Sys.time(), stats::runif(1))), 1, 10))     gcs_uri <- paste0(prefix, "/store")     gcs_out <- tryCatch(       {         st_both <- store_connect(uri, secondary = gcs_uri, create = TRUE)         start <- bench::hires_time()         store_sync(st_both, all = TRUE)         sync_s <- as.numeric(bench::hires_time() - start)         gcs_timed <- list()         holder <- new.env()         gcs_types <- strsplit(Sys.getenv("RCS_BENCH_GCS_QUERIES", paste(query_types, collapse = ";")), ";")[[1]]         for (vname in gcs_variants) {           v <- variants[[vname]]           for (qtype in intersect(query_types, gcs_types)) {             row <- time_type(function(y, s) run_variant(holder$st, y, v), qtype, vname, name,               run = "cold",               reconnect = rlang::expr({                 gcs_reset_clients()                 assign("st", store_connect(!!gcs_uri), envir = !!holder)               })             )             row$variant <- vname             row$complete <- TRUE             gcs_timed[[length(gcs_timed) + 1L]] <- row           }         }         list(timed = do.call(vctrs::vec_rbind, gcs_timed), sync_s = sync_s)       },       finally = {         be <- be_new(prefix)         left <- tryCatch(be_list(be), error = function(e) NULL)         if (!is.null(left) && nrow(left) > 0) be_delete(be, left$path)       }     )     gcs_out$timed$default_rule <- timed$default_rule[[1]]     timed <- vctrs::vec_rbind(timed, tibble::tibble(rows = n, layout = name, location = "gcs", gcs_out$timed))     facts$gcs_sync_s <- gcs_out$sync_s   }   list(timed = timed, counted = counted, facts = facts) }  for (name in chosen) {   spec <- layouts[layouts$layout == name, ]   if (nrow(spec) != 1) cli::cli_abort("Unknown layout {.val {name}}.")   out <- run_layout(as.list(spec))   save_merged(out$timed, "spatial")   save_merged(out$counted, "spatial-counters")   save_merged(out$facts, "spatial-layouts")   unlink(file.path(work, name), recursive = TRUE)   gc() } unlink(work, recursive = TRUE)

workers = 1L)) } cases <- cases[cases$n %in% sizes, ]  run_cases <- function() {   timed <- list()   counted <- list()   for (kind in unique(cases$kind)) {     for (n in unique(cases$n[cases$kind == )         steps_flush()         row <- cbind(row, tibble::as_tibble(steps_median()))         row$kind <- kind         row$rows <- n         row$location <- location         row$workers <- workers row$bytes_written <- sum(counters$n[counters$counter == "bytes_up"])           counted[[case]] <- counters_tidy(counters, st)         } else {           row$bytes_written <- NA_real_         }         timed[[case]] <- row         options(rcs.workers = 1)         if (workers > 1) mirai::daemons(0, .compute = "rcs")         unlink(list.files(work, full.names = TRUE), recursive = TRUE)       }       rm(x)       gc()     }   }   list(timed = do.call(rbind, timed), counted = do.call(rbind, counted)) }  remove_gcs_prefix <- function() {   if (!exists("gcs_prefix")) {     return(invisible())   }   be code: root <- file.path(tempdir(), "rcs-example-write") st <- store_connect(   file.path(root, "primary"),   secondary = file.path(root, "copy"),   create = TRUE ) sales <- rcs_sim_table(200, seed = 1) store_write(st, sales, "sales/daily",   title = "Daily sales",   description = "Simulated daily sales by shop and product.",   key = c("shop_id", "date", "product"), partition = "year" ) #> ℹ Writing "sales/daily": 200 rows in 2 files (partition year). #> ✔ primary    /tmp/Rtmp/rcs-example-write/primary  2/2 #>   files sent  27.9 kB  0.1s #> ✔ secondary  /tmp/Rtmp/rcs-example-write/copy     2/2 #>   files sent  27.9 kB  0.1s #> ✔ MD5 identical for 2 files in 2 locations. Catalogs updated.  # The same data again: nothing is uploaded store_write(st, sales, "sales/daily",   title = "Daily sales",   description = "Simulated daily sales by shop and product.",   key = c("shop_id", "date", "product"), partition = "year",   mode = "replace" ) #> ℹ "sales/daily" is unchanged (version 41ec22ed5b5602ce): 200 rows in 2 files #>   (partition year). #> ✔ primary    /tmp/Rtmp/rcs-example-write/primary  unchanged #> ✔ secondary  /tmp/Rtmp/rcs-example-write/copy     up #>   to date #> ✔ All 2 locations hold this version.  # Replace one year year_2024 <- sales[sales$year == 2024, ] year_2024$qty <- year_2024$qty + 1L store_write(st, year_2024, "sales/daily",   title = "Daily sales",   description = "Simulated daily sales by shop and product.",   mode = "update" ) #> ℹ Updating "sales/daily": 1 partition replaced, 0 added, 1 kept. #> • year = 2024: 97 rows -> 97 rows #> ℹ Writing "sales/daily": 200 rows in 2 files (partition year). #> ✔ primary    /tmp/Rtmp/rcs-example-write/primary  1/2 #>   files sent  13.9 kB  0.1s #> ✔ secondary  /tmp/Rtmp/rcs-example-write/copy     1/2 #>   files sent  13.9 kB  0.1s #> ✔ MD5 identical for 2 files in 2 locations. unavailable.  # A class map: the codes go into the file, the legend and the colours # into the catalog. `nodata = 0`: cells holding 0 are outside the map. if (requireNamespace("terra", quietly = TRUE)) {   cover <- terra::as.int(rcs_sim_raster(nrow = 60, ncol = 80)[["cover"]])   cover[1:2, ] <- 0L   levels(cover) <- data.frame(     value = 1:5,     label = c("water", "forest", "crop", "grass", "bare")   )   names(cover) <- "cover" # `levels<-` renamed the layer   terra::coltab(cover) <- data.frame(     value = 1:5,     col = c("#1F78B4", "#33A02C", "#FFD92F", "#B2DF8A", "#B15928")   )   store_write(st, cover, "grids/cover",     title = "Land cover", description = "A simulated class map.",     nodata = 0   )   # One byte per cell, the NoData value and the number of classes   print(store_describe(st, "grids/cover")$columns)    # A large map is best written straight from its file: the data type   # and the NoData tag of the file are kept. `gdal` changes the   # compression here.   file <- file.path(root, "cover.tif")   terra::writeRaster(cover, file, datatype = "INT1U", NAflag = 0)   store_write(st, terra::rast(file), "grids/cover_zstd",     title = "Land cover, ZSTD", description = "A simulated class map.",     gdal = c("COMPRESS=ZSTD", "LEVEL=9")   )   # The label column is named `cover` here, not `label`:   # `terra::writeRaster()` named it after the layer   print(terra::levels(store_read(st, "grids/cover_zstd"))[[1]]) } #> ℹ Writing "grids/cover": 4,800 cells in 1 file. #> ✔ primary    /tmp/Rtmp/rcs-example-write/primary  1/1 #>   files sent  1.9 kB  0.1s #> ✔ secondary  /tmp/Rtmp/rcs-example-write/copy     1/1 #>   files sent  1.9 kB  0.1s #> ✔ MD5 identical for 1 file in 2 locations.
